data.narrative:
QunaSys is a Series B quantum computing company that has raised $33M to date. The relevant comp universe comprises 3 public peers (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private-stage quantum computing firms including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable valuation method here. Using $33M in total raised as a proxy for entry valuation and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B to subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $63M. The peer-median approach is not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables within quantum computing; while 8 same-sector peers exist, none satisfy the threshold of 3 or more datapoints in the same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier. Relying on all-sector median would introduce undue noise.

The triangulated valuation range is $53M to $72M, with a median of $63M, supported by the single applicable method. The analysis carries material uncertainty given the reliance on stage-progression mechanics rather than market-based peer multiples. Deepening the dataset with additional Series B or Series C quantum computing valuations—whether through expanded private fundraising intelligence or public-market comparables—would strengthen conviction in this range.
